summary: Iter154 full-stack test of the Reports page rewrite + numbered-paging rollout to CRM Customers, Inventory, Appointments, and Reports Recent Invoices. Backend 4/4 pytest cases pass (/api/reports/sales returns new int unique_customers + prev{start,end,total_invoices,total_revenue,unique_customers} of same window length; /api/invoices rows include customer_phone; POST /api/auth/login with X-Tenant-Slug sets HTTPOnly cookies in the jar). Frontend: signed in as admin@miracurl.com on miracurl-marathahalli, dismissed 'Got it' modal, then /reports header (report-header, report-start=08/16/2026, report-end=09/15/2026, report-branch-filter, report-generate-btn) all render; top KPIs (report-top-kpis) show Total Sales ₹72,314 (-60% vs last), Total Invoices 25 (-74%), Unique Customers 16 (-52%), Avg. Bill ₹2,893 (+51%). Clicking Generate reloads on the same URL without console errors. Recent Invoices card (report-bill-lookup): range chips today/yesterday/week/month/custom present; Custom exposes bill-range-from/to date inputs; live filter by phone (9000000153 → 1 row); Export dropdown opens (bill-export-menu) with 'CSV — all N' + 'CSV — N selected', and clicking bill-export-all triggers a real download (invoices-custom.csv). Sortable Total header present. Edit button opens EditInvoiceModal for INV-202609-0251. Pager (crm-pager inside report-bill-lookup): default per-page=20 (verified via input_value); with Custom Range 2026-01-01→2026-12-31 backend returned 251 invoices → 'Showing 1–20 of 251 invoices', numbered buttons 1,2,3,4,5,…,13 render; clicking pager-page-2 loads a different first row and still shows 20; selecting per-page=50 shows exactly 50 rows. Lower sections: tips-report-card, loyalty-gifts-report-card, report-trend-kpis (report-period-revenue + report-invoice-trend + report-avg-rating + report-payment-mix), membership-report-card + mem-view-members (clicking it navigates to /plans?tab=memberships and plans-tab-memberships receives the active bg-violet-50/border-violet-300/text-violet-700 classes), monthly-revenue-card, weekly-revenue-card, staff-business-card, report-unbilled-panel, commission-card + commission-unlock-btn (Owner PIN 4321 unlock → card now renders 'Per-Stylist Commission … Staff' rows, no 500), tips-card — ALL 15 test-ids present. /customers: pager-per-page default 20, 20 customer-row-* visible, numbered pager-page-1 & pager-page-2 present, crm-recent-invoices sub-card renders. /inventory: crm-pager renders 'Showing 1–6 of 6 products' (fewer than 20 so no page 2, per spec), inv-tab-retail + inv-tab-in_house filter tabs present, perPage default=20. /appointments (Day view): crm-pager renders 'Showing 1–4 of 4 bookings' — correct noun. Only console noise: React hydration warnings from the visual-editor's <span> injected inside <option>, and expected 401/403/404 (unauth pre-login, commission-before-unlock, one missing static resource on inventory) — no functional errors.

issues: Optional: 'From' input auto-fills as monthAgo (08/16) which does not match 'This Month' chip default in Recent Invoices — mild confusion but per-spec.

critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx line 82 error handler falls through when /reports/sales fails — 'data' stays null which then keeps 'Loading report…' spinner. Consider setting a hasError state so the lower tree renders empty cards instead of an infinite loading placeholder.

BillLookup.jsx: search form onSubmit calls load() which re-fetches ALL 500 invoices from server, but filtering is already done client-side via filterInvoices — the network round-trip on 'Search' button is redundant and can make the UI feel slow. Consider making Search a no-op (or debounced input only).

invoiceUtils.rangeBounds 'week' start uses local Date().getDay() but istDay uses Asia/Kolkata — for tenants whose browser is not IST this will drift a day around 12–6 AM UTC. Consider computing the day-of-week from an IST date string.

CrmBits.usePager stores page in local state; if `rows` shrinks (e.g. filter narrows to <perPage) the pager auto-clamps 'cur' but does NOT setPage(1), so 'from' still reads (page-1)*perPage+1 e.g. 21 while total=3. Minor edge cosmetics only.

React hydration warning 'span cannot be a child of option' comes from the visual-editor DOM instrumentation on <select><option> inside MiraDayOffer and Reports branch filter — not a runtime bug, but if visual-editor stays enabled in prod builds it will spam console.
